svg.title: Copper paired-sphere metrology: assumed component x/y top plan
svg.desc: Uniform x/y top plan projection of declared illustrative component bounding geometry, with reference numerals explained in the companion dossier. Not a wiring diagram, scale drawing or built apparatus. Black line A4 drafting study.
